messages:
Emma (AE): QuantumHealth asked whether Redwood can do a POC that demonstrates multi-tenant domain isolation: they run 3 hospitals under one org and want per-tenant domain proofs + strict RBAC segregation. Also question on SCIM provisioning rate SLA and per-provision billing.
Ravi (SE): We support per-tenant domain verification via DNS TXT. For POC we can manually verify all three; automation across many domains is product work. RBAC segregation: we already partition roles per tenant and scoping keys. Need their group names to map.
Noor (Sec): Security items: they want assertion encryption + signed responses and IdP-initiated SLO. We support encrypted assertions (RSA-OAEP + AES-GCM) and signed responses. IdP-initiated SLO we support but depends on SP cookie handling.
Hector (Infra): Important: SCIM cross-tenant provisioning (push from central IdP into multiple tenant partitions) is doable. For throttles: hosted default is 60 req/min per tenant; for POC we can request a temporary bump to 300 req/min for a 24h window. For SLAs on SCIM throughput, hosted is best-effort; Dedicated can have an SLA negotiated.
Jade (PM): Billing question: they asked if SCIM provisioning is billed per-user or per-request. Current pricing is per-provisioning unit (roughly per 1000 users/month) for bulk provisioning plus token usage; we can provide a POC pricing credit. If they want Dedicated short trial, Sales Ops needs to approve a reduced commit.
Olga (Legal): They requested contractual language: 1) we won't be liable for DNS propagation delays during domain proofing, 2) explicit handling of multi-tenant data segregation in contract. I'll draft standard clauses; need technical wording from Eng to align.
Ravi (SE): For RBAC mapping: SCIM groups -> tenant-scoped roles. We can also map SAML attributes for ephemeral elevation. Example: "hospitalA_admins" -> "tenant:hospitalA:admin". If they need nested roles we can emulate with group naming.
Noor (Sec): Session revoke on SCIM deprovision: supported via webhook + token blacklist. Hosted propagation typical <60s; Dedicated can be configured to tighter windows. Note: SP-side SSO cookies may persist.
Hector (Infra): Private/VPC POC takes ~10 business days. Hosted with tenant pin + CMK is 48-72h. For billing & infra: if they require sustained provisioning >250 QPS, Dedicated recommended.
Emma (AE): Can someone give me a short one-pager for the buyer covering: domain proofing steps, SCIM bulk import path & rate bump, RBAC mapping example, SAML/SLO support, and commercial options?
Ravi (SE): I'll draft the one-pager with a mapping example and required artifacts (SP metadata, sample CSV, list of domains, KMS ARN) by EOD.
Noor (Sec): I'll add the security responses for the questionnaire and cert requirements.
Olga (Legal): I'll add the contract snippets and DPA note.
ops-bot: Action scheduled: "poc-scim-rate-bump" will run in staging in 2h for a 24h window. Reply "abort" to cancel.
Emma (AE): Thanks team 44d I'll send to QuantumHealth and loop Sales Ops if they push Dedicated trial.
